label: the build box size ignores PAW_SITES_BUILD_MEMORY_GIB, so ops cannot shrink it from the usage lines
find: memory_gb = env_memory if memory_gb is None else memory_gb
replace: memory_gb = DEFAULT_BUILD_MEMORY_GIB if memory_gb is None else memory_gb

label: a bad build size env value (0, negative) reaches Daytona instead of falling back to the default
find:
if value < 1:
        logger.warning("%s=%r is not a positive integer; using %d", name, raw, default)
replace:
if value < -100:
        logger.warning("%s=%r is not a positive integer; using %d", name, raw, default)

label: a probe that raises fails the whole build instead of logging unknowns
find: except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 -- measuring must never fail a build
replace: except ValueError as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 -- measuring must never fail a build

label: a hung probe is not cut off, so a wedged exec holds the build (and its sandbox) open
the probe drops the cgroup v2 peak, so builds log a /proc used-now figure instead of the real peak
